blurb.en: Scatter random whole-number points over a square and count how many land inside the quarter circle: four times that share is close to pi. Four times as many points only halve the error.
blurb.zh: 在正方形里随机撒整点，数一数落进四分之一圆的有多少：这个比例乘以 4 就接近 π。点数翻四倍，误差才减半。

en: The square runs from 0 to R along each side, and the quarter circle of radius R sits in its corner. The quarter circle's area is pi times R squared over 4 and the square's is R squared, so the share of random points that land inside the circle is about pi over 4 - multiply by 4 and pi is left. The points are whole numbers from 0 to R - 1 so that the inside test is exact whole-number arithmetic; with R = 10000 the possible points are packed so tightly that this makes no visible difference.

The randomness lives only in random_points, which is handed the generator rng as an argument; count_inside is a plain function of a list of points. That split is what this whole page is about: the part that does the logic receives its random numbers instead of making them, so it can be checked on any points at all - the page's checker compares it with a different way of counting on hundreds of made-up lists of points, points exactly on the circle included. rng is random.Random(2026), a generator with a fixed seed, so every run produces the same numbers.

With this seed, one run of 10000 points estimates pi as 3.1584. The table then averages the error over 50 runs at each size: 0.0641 for 400 points, 0.0363 for 1600, 0.0193 for 6400 and 0.009 for 25600. Four times as many points roughly halve the error, so doubling the points only divides it by about 1.4, the square root of 2. The error shrinks like one over the square root of the number of points, which is why a Monte Carlo estimate is easy to write and slow to sharpen. Another seed gives different digits and the same pattern.
zh: 正方形每条边从 0 到 R，半径为 R 的四分之一圆贴在它的角上。四分之一圆的面积是 π 乘 R 的平方再除以 4，正方形是 R 的平方，所以随机点落进圆里的比例约等于 π / 4——乘以 4，剩下的就是 π。点取 0 到 R - 1 的整数，这样判断在不在圆里是精确的整数运算；R = 10000 时，可取的点已经密到这一点看不出差别。

随机只出现在 random_points 里，而且随机数生成器 rng 是当实参交给它的；count_inside 只是一个「给一张点表、数出一个数」的普通函数。这样分开正是这一页要讲的事：做逻辑的那部分不自己造随机数、而是收下随机数，于是它可以拿任何点来检验——页面的检查器用另一种数法，在几百张随手造的点表上跟它对答案，正好落在圆周上的点也在其中。rng 是 random.Random(2026)，种子固定的生成器，每次运行都得到同一串数。

这个种子下，一次撒 10000 个点，估出的 π 是 3.1584。接下来的表对每种点数跑 50 次、取误差的平均：400 个点 0.0641，1600 个 0.0363，6400 个 0.0193，25600 个 0.009。点数翻四倍，误差大约减半；所以点数只翻一倍时，误差只除以约 1.4，也就是根号 2。误差按「点数的平方根分之一」缩小——这正是蒙特卡洛估计好写、却难以算准的原因。换一个种子，数字会变，规律不变。

lineNotes.en: A generator of its own with a fixed seed: the same numbers on every run, and nothing else in the program draws from it.
lineNotes.zh: 一个属于自己的随机数生成器，种子固定：每次运行都是同一串数，程序里也没有别的地方从它取数。

title.en: Estimating Pi on a Regular Grid

blurb.en: The same share with no randomness at all: cut the square into n by n cells and count the cells whose centre lies inside the quarter circle. The error falls much faster than with random points.
blurb.zh: 同一个比例，完全不用随机数：把正方形切成 n × n 个小格，数中心落在四分之一圆里的格子。误差比随机撒点降得快得多。

en: Each cell (x, y) of the n by n square is tested at its centre, x + 0.5 and y + 0.5, against a quarter circle of radius n. Halves are awkward, so the test doubles both sides of the inequality and then squares them: the centre is inside when the square of 2x + 1 plus the square of 2y + 1 is at most the square of 2n. Everything is now a whole number, and the test is exact.

This is systematic sampling: the points are spread evenly on purpose instead of by chance. Random points can bunch up in one place and leave a gap in another; a grid cannot. For the same number of points the grid wins by a long way: with 6400 points (side 80) it is off by 0.00028, while Estimating Pi with Random Points averaged an error of 0.0193 at the same size.

The grid's error does not fall smoothly. Sides 10 and 20 both give 3.16000; side 40 gives 3.14000; side 160 (off by 0.00106) does worse than side 80; side 320, with 102400 points, lands within 0.00003. Whether a row of centres falls just inside or just outside the curve changes in jumps from one size to the next. What the grid gives up is chance itself: there is no seed, so the program prints the same table on every run and on every computer.
zh: n × n 正方形里的每个格子 (x, y) 都拿它的中心 (x + 0.5, y + 0.5) 去比，圆是半径为 n 的四分之一圆。带 0.5 不好算，所以把不等式两边先乘 2 再平方：2x + 1 的平方加上 2y + 1 的平方不超过 2n 的平方，中心就在圆里。这样一来全是整数，判断是精确的。
这叫系统抽样：点是有意均匀铺开的，不靠运气。随机撒的点可能在一处挤成一团、在另一处留出空白；网格不会。同样多的点，网格好得多：6400 个点（边长 80）时误差是 0.00028，而「随机撒点估 π」在同样点数下的平均误差是 0.0193。
网格的误差并不是平稳下降的。边长 10 与 20 都得到 3.16000；边长 40 得到 3.14000；边长 160（误差 0.00106）反而比边长 80 差；边长 320、共 102400 个点时，误差在 0.00003 以内。一排中心是刚好落在曲线里面还是外面，随尺寸跳来跳去。网格放弃的是随机本身：没有种子，所以这个程序在每次运行、每台电脑上打印的都是同一张表。

lineNotes.en: Every one of the n * n cells is visited: side 320 means 102400 tests.
lineNotes.zh: n * n 个格子每个都要看一遍：边长 320 就是 102400 次判断。

blurb.en: Roll two dice 100 times and then 10000 times, tally the totals, and set the frequencies beside the exact chances worked out from the 36 equally likely pairs.
blurb.zh: 两颗骰子先掷 100 次、再掷 10000 次，数出每个点数和各出现几次，再与从 36 种同样可能的组合算出的精确概率并排比较。

en: tally turns a list of rolls into a table of counts indexed by the total. The same function also gives the exact answer: hand it each of the 36 pairs from (1, 1) to (6, 6) once, and each slot holds the number of ways to make that total - 1 way for 2, 6 ways for 7, 1 way for 12. Dividing by 36 turns a number of ways into a chance.

The rolls are made in roll_many with rng = random.Random(7) and handed to tally, which never touches randomness itself. With this seed, 100 rolls give a total of 7 a frequency of 0.100 against a chance of 0.167, and a total of 4 only 0.030 against 0.083; the biggest gap over all the totals is 0.067. With 10000 rolls the biggest gap is 0.004. Frequencies approach the chances as the number of rolls grows, but any one run of 100 can be well off. Another seed moves these numbers, not the pattern.
The program only counts. How far off a given number of rolls is likely to be, and how to test whether a die is fair, are questions for statistics.
zh: tally 把一张投掷记录表变成一张按点数和编号的计数表。同一个函数也给出精确答案：把 (1, 1) 到 (6, 6) 这 36 种组合各交给它一次，每一格就是凑出这个和的组合数——2 有 1 种，7 有 6 种，12 有 1 种。组合数除以 36 就是概率。

投掷在 roll_many 里用 rng = random.Random(7) 造出来，再交给 tally；tally 自己从不碰随机数。这个种子下，掷 100 次时和为 7 的频率是 0.100，而概率是 0.167；和为 4 的只有 0.030，概率是 0.083；所有和里差得最多的是 0.067。掷 10000 次时，差得最多的只有 0.004。掷的次数越多，频率越靠近概率，但单独一轮 100 次可能差得不少。换一个种子，这些数会变，规律不变。
这个程序只负责数。掷多少次大概会差多少、怎样检验一颗骰子公不公平，是统计要回答的问题。

lineNotes.en: Slots 0 and 1 are never used; they make the index equal the total.
lineNotes.zh: 0 号和 1 号两格永远用不上；留着它们，下标才等于点数和。

title.en: A Random Walk on a Line

blurb.en: Take steps of +1 or -1 at random and record where the walk ends, how far it strays and how often it comes back to 0. The typical distance grows only like the square root of the number of steps.
blurb.zh: 随机地走 +1 或 -1 步，记下终点在哪、离原点最远多远、回到原点几次。典型的距离只按步数的平方根增长。

en: walk_stats receives the whole list of steps and walks through it once, keeping three things up to date: the position, the record distance from 0 (on either side, hence abs) and the number of times the position is exactly 0 again. The steps come from random_steps, which picks +1 or -1 with rng.choice; walk_stats itself works on any list of plus and minus ones.

With rng = random.Random(11), the first walk of 1000 steps ends at -24, strays at most 42 from the start and comes back to 0 four times. Then 400 walks are averaged for each length: the mean distance of the end point from 0 is 8.2 after 100 steps, 15.3 after 400 and 32.4 after 1600. Four times as many steps only about double the distance: it grows like the square root of the number of steps, because steps in opposite directions keep cancelling out. Another seed gives other numbers with the same doubling.

The same shape of result - four times the work for twice the effect - turned up in Estimating Pi with Random Points, and for a related reason: both add up many independent random plus-or-minus contributions.
zh: walk_stats 收下整张步子表，从头走一遍，同时更新三样东西：位置、离 0 最远的纪录（哪一边都算，所以用 abs）、位置又正好回到 0 的次数。步子由 random_steps 用 rng.choice 在 +1 与 -1 里挑；walk_stats 本身对任何一张由正负 1 组成的表都适用。
rng = random.Random(11) 时，第一次走 1000 步：终点在 -24，离起点最远 42，回到 0 四次。接着每种步数各走 400 次取平均：终点离 0 的平均距离，100 步是 8.2，400 步是 15.3，1600 步是 32.4。步数翻四倍，距离只大约翻一倍：它按步数的平方根增长，因为方向相反的步子一直在互相抵消。换一个种子，数字不同，翻一倍的规律相同。
「翻四倍的功夫只换来一倍的效果」这个样子，在「随机撒点估 π」里也出现过，原因也相近：两者都是把许多互不相干、有正有负的随机量加在一起。

lineNotes.en: Only the end point is needed here, so the other two results go to underscores.
lineNotes.zh: 这里只要终点，另外两个结果交给下划线。

run.expect:
one walk of 1000 steps: end -24 farthest 42 returns 4
steps mean_distance
100 8.2
400 15.3
1600 32.4

blurb.en: A random walk with walls: start with some money, win or lose 1 on each fair coin flip, and stop at 0 or at the target. The share of games won matches start divided by target.
blurb.zh: 带墙的随机游走：带着一些钱开局，每抛一次公平硬币赢或输 1，到 0 或到目标就停。赢的局数占比与「起始钱数 ÷ 目标」相符。

en: This is A Random Walk on a Line with a wall at each end. play takes the starting money, the target and a list of coin flips (+1 or -1), and returns two things: how the game ended and after how many flips. There are three endings: the money reaches 0 (ruined), it reaches the target (won), or the list of flips runs out first (unfinished). Starting at 0 or at the target, the while condition is false straight away and the game is over after 0 flips.

simulate makes 300 flips per game with rng and plays 1000 games from each start, with a target of 10. For a fair coin, theory says the chance of winning is start divided by target, and the mean number of flips is start times (target minus start). With rng = random.Random(5): starting at 1, 0.107 of the games are won (theory 0.100) after 9.4 flips on average (theory 9); at 3, 0.311 and 21.5 (0.300 and 21); at 5, 0.493 and 24.3 (0.500 and 25); at 9, 0.898 and 10.0 (0.900 and 9). Another seed changes the later digits, not the agreement.

300 flips are far more than a game here needs, so no game in the demo ends unfinished. The unfinished branch is still needed, because play accepts any list of flips, including a short one - and the page's checker feeds it short ones.
zh: 这就是「一维随机游走」两头各加一堵墙。play 收下起始钱数、目标和一张抛硬币结果表（+1 或 -1），交回两样东西：游戏怎么结束的、抛了几次。结局有三种：钱输到 0（ruined）、钱到了目标（won）、还没碰到哪一头硬币就抛完了（unfinished）。起始就在 0 或目标上时，while 的条件一上来就不成立，游戏在 0 次之后就结束了。

simulate 每局用 rng 造 300 次抛硬币，从每个起点各玩 1000 局，目标是 10。对公平硬币，理论上赢的概率是「起始 ÷ 目标」，平均抛的次数是「起始 × (目标 − 起始)」。rng = random.Random(5) 时：从 1 出发，赢的占 0.107（理论 0.100），平均抛 9.4 次（理论 9）；从 3 出发，0.311 与 21.5（0.300 与 21）；从 5 出发，0.493 与 24.3（0.500 与 25）；从 9 出发，0.898 与 10.0（0.900 与 9）。换一个种子，后几位会变，吻合不变。
300 次对这里的一局来说绰绰有余，所以演示里没有一局以 unfinished 结束。但这一支仍然必要：play 接受任何一张抛硬币表，包括很短的——页面的检查器就专门喂它短的。

lineNotes.en: Out of flips before either wall: this list cannot decide the game.
lineNotes.zh: 两堵墙都没碰到，硬币就抛完了：这张表决定不了胜负。

blurb.en: Customers arrive at random gaps and need random service times at one till. Work out each customer's wait, the mean and longest wait and the longest line - and watch the waits explode as the till gets busier.
blurb.zh: 顾客隔随机的时间到达、在唯一的柜台前各要一段随机的服务时间。算出每个人等了多久、平均与最长等待、最长的队——再看柜台越忙，等待怎样暴涨。

en: simulate jumps from one arrival to the next instead of ticking minute by minute. For each customer: the clock moves on by her gap; she starts at whichever is later, her arrival or the moment the till is free; her wait is the difference; and the till is next free once her service is over. line holds the start times of the people still waiting, and before it is measured, everyone whose start time has come is removed from the front. deque is only the container here - how it works is on the Stacks & Queues page.

The small example has arrivals at minutes 0, 1, 2 and 7 with services of 3, 3, 1 and 2 minutes: the waits are 0, 2, 4 and 0, and at most 2 people stand in line at once. run then makes 1000 customers with rng = random.Random(42): gaps of 1 to 6 minutes (3.5 on average) and services of 1 minute up to slowest.

With services up to 3 minutes the mean wait is 0.42 minutes and the line never holds more than 2; up to 4 minutes, 1.13 and 4; up to 5, 3.54 and 6. Up to 6 minutes, the till needs 3.5 minutes per customer on average - exactly as long as the average gap between arrivals - and the mean wait jumps to 49.12 minutes, the longest wait to 110, with 34 people in line. A till that is busy nearly all the time never catches up. These are the values for seed 42; other seeds give other numbers and the same jump at the end.
zh: simulate 从一位顾客的到达跳到下一位的到达，而不是一分钟一分钟地走。对每位顾客：时钟前进她那段间隔；她开始被服务的时刻，是她到达与柜台空出来两者里较晚的那个；等待就是两者之差；她的服务结束时，柜台再次空出来。line 里存的是还在等的人的开始时刻；量队长之前，先把开始时刻已到的人从队首移走。deque 在这里只当容器用——它怎么工作见「栈与队列」一页。
小例子里，顾客在第 0、1、2、7 分钟到达，服务时长分别是 3、3、1、2 分钟：四人各等 0、2、4、0 分钟，队伍里同时最多站 2 个人。接着 run 用 rng = random.Random(42) 造 1000 位顾客：到达间隔 1 到 6 分钟（平均 3.5），服务时长 1 分钟到 slowest 分钟。

服务最长 3 分钟时，平均等 0.42 分钟，队伍从不超过 2 人；最长 4 分钟时，1.13 分钟、4 人；最长 5 分钟时，3.54 分钟、6 人。最长 6 分钟时，柜台平均每人要 3.5 分钟——正好等于平均到达间隔——平均等待猛增到 49.12 分钟，最长等 110 分钟，队伍排到 34 人。一个几乎一刻不停的柜台永远追不上。这些是种子 42 下的值；换一个种子数字不同，最后那一下暴涨照样出现。

lineNotes.en: Everyone whose start time has come has left the line for the till.
lineNotes.zh: 开始时刻已到的人都已离开队伍、走到了柜台前。

title.en: Game of Life on a Bounded Grid

blurb.en: Conway's rules on a fixed table of 0s and 1s: count each cell's eight neighbours, build the whole next generation, and only then replace the old one.
blurb.zh: 在一张固定大小的 0/1 表上跑康威的规则：每格数 8 个邻居，先把完整的下一代算出来，再替换旧的一代。

en: The rules: a live cell with 2 or 3 live neighbours stays alive, a dead cell with exactly 3 live neighbours comes alive, and every other cell is dead in the next generation. live_neighbours looks at the eight cells around one cell and skips any that fall off the edge of the table.

step writes into a brand new table and never changes grid. That matters: if cells were updated in place, a cell further along would count some neighbours that already belong to the next generation, and the rules would be applied to a mixture of two generations. Every cell must see the same old generation, so the demo swaps in the new table only once it is complete.

The demo puts a glider in the top-left corner of a 6 by 6 table and shows every fourth generation. Every 4 generations the glider has the same 5-cell shape, moved one row down and one column right. At generation 16 it has run into the bottom-right corner: only 4 cells are left, a 2 by 2 block that never changes again. The edge of the table has changed the pattern; Game of Life on an Unbounded Plane has no edge to run into.
zh: 规则：活细胞有 2 个或 3 个活邻居就活下去，死细胞正好有 3 个活邻居就活过来，其余的格子在下一代都是死的。live_neighbours 看一个格子周围的 8 格，落到表外的跳过。
step 往一张全新的表里写，从不改 grid。这一点要紧：如果就地更新，后面的格子数邻居时会数到几个已经属于下一代的格子，规则就被用在两代混杂的局面上了。每个格子看到的必须是同一个旧的一代，所以演示等新表整张算完，才换上它。
演示把一个滑翔机放在 6 × 6 表的左上角，每隔四代显示一次。每过 4 代，滑翔机还是同样的 5 格形状，只是往下、往右各挪了一格。到第 16 代，它撞进了右下角：只剩 4 个活细胞，成了一个 2 × 2 的方块，从此再也不变。是表的边缘改变了图案；「无边界的生命游戏」里没有边缘可撞。

lineNotes.en: A cell is not its own neighbour.
lineNotes.zh: 格子自己不算自己的邻居。

title.en: Game of Life on an Unbounded Plane

blurb.en: Store only the live cells, as a set of (row, col) pairs. Each live cell gives its eight neighbours one vote; the votes decide the next generation, and the plane has no edges.
blurb.zh: 只存活细胞，存成一个 (行, 列) 坐标的集合。每个活细胞给自己的 8 个邻格各投一票；票数决定下一代，平面没有边。

en: A table has to be made big enough in advance; a set holds only the live cells, wherever they are, with negative coordinates as welcome as positive ones. Instead of looking at every cell, step starts from the live cells and works outwards: each live cell adds one vote to each of its eight neighbours in the dictionary counts. A cell's votes are then exactly its number of live neighbours, and a cell that no live cell touches is never looked at.

The next generation is built as a new set from the votes, so the old set is never changed while it is being read - the same rule as in Game of Life on a Bounded Grid. A dead cell with no votes never appears in counts, which is fine: with 0 live neighbours it stays dead.

The demo runs the same glider for 40 generations: it is the same 5 cells, moved 10 rows down and 10 columns right, and nothing stopped it. Then the R-pentomino, 5 cells to begin with, has 33 live cells at generation 40, 67 at 80, 148 at 120, 185 at 160 and 120 at 200 - a small start that spreads well beyond where it began, which a table of fixed size could not have held.
zh: 表得事先开得够大；集合只存活细胞，不管它们在哪儿，负坐标与正坐标一样可以。step 不逐格去看，而是从活细胞出发往外数：每个活细胞在字典 counts 里给自己的 8 个邻格各投一票。于是一个格子得到的票数正好是它的活邻居数，没有任何活细胞挨着的格子根本不会被看到。
下一代按票数另建一个新集合，所以旧集合在被读的时候从来不会被改——与「有边界的生命游戏」同一条规矩。没有票的死格子不会出现在 counts 里，这没关系：活邻居是 0，它照样是死的。
演示把同一个滑翔机跑 40 代：还是那 5 个格子，往下挪了 10 行、往右挪了 10 列，一路没有东西拦它。接着是 R 五连块，开局只有 5 个格子：第 40 代有 33 个活细胞，第 80 代 67 个，第 120 代 148 个，第 160 代 185 个，第 200 代 120 个——一个很小的开局，一直蔓延到远离起点的地方，固定大小的表装不下它。

lineNotes.at: print("same shape, moved:", later == {(r + 10, c + 10) for r, c in glider})
lineNotes.en: A set comprehension builds the glider moved 10 in both directions; == on two sets ignores order.
lineNotes.zh: 一个集合推导式造出往两个方向都挪了 10 的滑翔机；两个集合用 == 比较时不看顺序。

title.zh: 逐日推进的传染病模型（SIR）

blurb.en: Split a population into susceptible, infected and recovered people and move it forward one day at a time. Every new value must come from the old values - updating them one at a time quietly loses people.
blurb.zh: 把人群分成易感、感染、康复三组，一天一天往前推。每个新值都必须用旧值算——一个一个地更新，人会悄悄变少。

en: Each day, contacts between susceptible and infected people cause beta times S times I divided by the total N new infections, and a share gamma of the infected recover. Here beta is 0.3 and gamma 0.1, and the town starts with 990 susceptible and 10 infected out of 1000. The model is a difference equation: tomorrow's numbers are worked out from today's.

step works out the two amounts first and then hands back all three new values in one tuple, so every one of them comes from the old s, i and r. step_one_at_a_time changes s first and then uses the new s to work out i, and the new i to work out r, so the number of people who leave S is not the number who arrive in I. With simultaneous updates the total after 120 days is 1000.000000; one at a time it has fallen to 947.230896 - about 53 people have vanished.

With these numbers, the infected peak on day 28 at 315.9 people. By day 120 there are 52.6 susceptible, 0.2 infected and 947.2 recovered: the epidemic dies out before everyone has caught it. The daily values and the peak are printed to one decimal place with a format specifier - fractions of a person only mean something roughly; the two totals are printed to six decimal places so that the gap between them shows.
zh: 每天，易感者与感染者的接触带来 beta × S × I ÷ 总人数 N 个新感染，感染者里又有 gamma 这么大的比例康复。这里 beta 是 0.3、gamma 是 0.1，全镇 1000 人，开始时 990 人易感、10 人感染。这个模型是差分方程：明天的数由今天的数算出来。
step 先算出两个量，再用一个元组一次交回三个新值，所以三个新值都出自旧的 s、i、r。step_one_at_a_time 先改 s，再用新的 s 算 i、用新的 i 算 r，于是离开 S 的人数与进入 I 的人数对不上。同时更新时，120 天后总人数是 1000.000000；一个一个更新时，掉到了 947.230896——大约 53 个人凭空消失了。
在这组数下，感染人数在第 28 天达到峰值，315.9 人。到第 120 天，易感 52.6、感染 0.2、康复 947.2：疫情在所有人都染上之前就熄灭了。每天的数值与峰值用格式说明符打印到一位小数——几分之一个人本来就只是个大概；最后两个总人数则打印到六位小数，好看出两者差在哪里。

lineNotes.at: s = s - beta * s * i / n
lineNotes.en: From here on s is the new value, and the next line uses it: the mistake this program is about.
lineNotes.zh: 从这一行起 s 已经是新值，下一行就用上了它：这正是这个程序要讲的那个错。

title.en: A Traffic Light as a State Machine

blurb.en: A UK traffic light goes red, red and amber, green, amber, red. Write it as a finite state machine: a table of which state comes next, a table of how long each one lasts, and a loop that ticks.
blurb.zh: 英国的交通灯按 红、红黄、绿、黄、红 循环。把它写成有限状态机：一张「下一个是谁」的表，一张「每个状态持续多久」的表，再加一个逐拍走的循环。

en: A finite state machine is always in exactly one of a fixed set of states and moves between them by rules called transitions. Here there are four states and one kind of event, time running out. NEXT is the transition table: for each state, the state that follows it. DURATION says how many ticks each state lasts.

run keeps two variables: the current state and the ticks it has left. Every tick it records the state and counts down; at zero it follows the transition table and restarts the count from the duration table. Nothing inside run mentions red or green - everything about this light is in the two dictionaries. The same behaviour could be written as an if chain with one branch per state, each branch knowing its own duration and successor; then changing the light means editing code, while with tables it means editing data, and with more states and events the tables stay readable long after an if chain has not.

Starting at red, ticks 0 to 3 are red, tick 4 is red and amber, 5 to 7 are green, 8 is amber and 9 is red again. A full cycle is 4 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 9 ticks, which is why 20 ticks from green are the same as ticks 9 to 28 of a 29-tick run from green: after one cycle the machine is back in the same state with the same time left.
zh: 有限状态机在任何时刻都恰好处在一组固定状态中的一个，按叫作「转移」的规则在状态之间移动。这里有四个状态、一种事件：时间到了。NEXT 是转移表：每个状态之后接哪个状态。DURATION 说每个状态持续几拍。
run 只记两个变量：当前状态、这个状态还剩几拍。每一拍先记下状态、再倒数一拍；数到零就按转移表换状态，再按时长表重新计数。run 里一个字也没提红或绿——这盏灯的全部知识都在两个字典里。同样的行为也可以写成 if 链，每个状态一个分支，各自写死自己的时长与下一个状态；那样改灯就得改代码，用表则只改数据。状态与事件一多，表依然好读，if 链早就读不下去了。
从红灯开始：第 0 到 3 拍是红，第 4 拍红黄，第 5 到 7 拍绿，第 8 拍黄，第 9 拍又是红。一整圈是 4 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 9 拍，所以从绿灯起走 20 拍，与从绿灯起走 29 拍的第 9 到 28 拍完全一样：过了一圈，状态机回到同一个状态、剩下同样的拍数。

lineNotes.en: One tick of this state's time has been used up.
lineNotes.zh: 这个状态的时间用掉了一拍。

blurb.en: Walk backwards through the list and swap each slot with a random slot at or before it. Every one of the possible orders comes out equally often.
blurb.zh: 从表尾往前走，每一格与它自己或它前面随机挑中的一格交换。所有可能的排列出现得一样多。

en: At each step the slots after i are already settled. j is picked from 0 to i, i included, and whatever is at j is swapped into slot i, which settles it. Slot i has i + 1 equally likely candidates, so for n items there are n times (n - 1) times ... times 2 equally likely ways for the loop to run - exactly n factorial, one for each order. Picking i itself is allowed and leaves that item where it is; leaving it out is a classic slip that makes some orders impossible.

shuffle changes the list it is given and returns nothing, like list.sort(). shuffled_copy copies first and returns the copy, the way sorted() does, and makes its own generator from a seed. Python's random.Random(seed).shuffle runs this same algorithm, so with the same seed it gives the same order - which is how the page's checker tests this program.

The demo shuffles the numbers 0 to 9 once with seed 3, then shuffles the three cards A, B and C 6000 times with random.Random(2026). Each of the 6 orders should come up about 1000 times; with this seed the counts run from 916 (BAC) to 1039 (CAB). Another seed gives other counts, spread just as evenly. Compare Naive Shuffle: Why It Is Biased, where the same 6000 shuffles come out lopsided.
zh: 每一步开始时，i 后面的格子都已经定下来了。j 从 0 到 i（含 i）里挑，把 j 处的东西换到 i 号格，i 号格就此定下。i 号格有 i + 1 个同样可能的候选，所以 n 个元素时，循环一共有 n × (n − 1) × … × 2 种同样可能的走法——正好 n 的阶乘种，每种排列一种。挑中 i 自己是允许的，意思是那一项留在原地；把它漏掉是个经典失误，会让某些排列根本出不来。
shuffle 改动交给它的那张表、什么也不返回，和 list.sort() 一样。shuffled_copy 先复制、交回复制品，和 sorted() 一样，并且用种子自己造一个生成器。Python 的 random.Random(seed).shuffle 跑的就是这同一个算法，所以同一个种子下两者给出同一个顺序——页面的检查器就是这样检验这个程序的。
演示先用种子 3 把 0 到 9 洗一次，再用 random.Random(2026) 把 A、B、C 三张牌洗 6000 次。6 种顺序各应出现约 1000 次；这个种子下，次数从 916（BAC）到 1039（CAB）。换一个种子，次数不同，同样均匀。对照「天真的洗牌：为什么不均匀」：同样洗 6000 次，结果明显一边倒。

lineNotes.en: The copy is shuffled, never the caller's list.
lineNotes.zh: 洗的是复制品，调用者的表一点不动。

title.en: Naive Shuffle: Why It Is Biased
title.zh: 天真的洗牌：为什么不均匀

blurb.en: Swap every slot with any slot at all: it looks like a shuffle, but with three cards some orders come up 5 times in 27 and others only 4. Counting all 27 paths shows why.
blurb.zh: 每一格都与任意一格交换：看上去像洗牌，可三张牌时，有的顺序 27 次里出现 5 次，有的只有 4 次。把 27 条路径全数一遍，原因就清楚了。

en: The mistake is small: every slot is swapped with a position picked from all n slots, not just from the slots not yet settled. naive_shuffle takes the picks as a list, choices, so the same function can be driven by random picks or by every possible list of picks.

With three cards there are 3 times 3 times 3 = 27 equally likely lists of picks, but only 6 orders, and 27 cannot be shared out equally among 6 - so some orders must come up more often than others, whatever the details. itertools.product produces all 27 lists, and counting them gives the exact shares: ABC, CAB and CBA come from 4 lists each, and ACB, BAC and BCA from 5. Fisher-Yates Shuffle has 3 times 2 = 6 equally likely paths for 6 orders, one each.

The 6000 random shuffles with random.Random(2026) agree: ABC 957, ACB 1066, BAC 1074, BCA 1133, CAB 856 and CBA 914, where a fair shuffle would give about 1000 each; 4 in 27 of 6000 is about 889 and 5 in 27 about 1111. For longer lists it only gets worse: n to the power n paths shared among n factorial orders never divide evenly once n is more than 2.
zh: 错只错在一点：每一格都与从全部 n 个位置里挑出的一格交换，而不是只从还没定下来的格子里挑。naive_shuffle 把挑选结果当作一张表 choices 收进来，于是同一个函数既能由随机挑选驱动，也能把每一种可能的挑法都走一遍。

三张牌时，挑法一共 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 种、种种同样可能，排列却只有 6 种；27 分不成 6 等份——所以不管细节如何，总有些顺序比别的出现得多。itertools.product 造出全部 27 张挑选表，数一遍就得到精确的份额：ABC、CAB、CBA 各来自 4 张，ACB、BAC、BCA 各来自 5 张。「Fisher-Yates 洗牌」则是 3 × 2 = 6 条同样可能的路径对 6 种顺序，一条对一种。
用 random.Random(2026) 随机洗 6000 次，结果吻合：ABC 957、ACB 1066、BAC 1074、BCA 1133、CAB 856、CBA 914，而公平的洗牌应该各约 1000 次；6000 的 27 分之 4 约是 889，27 分之 5 约是 1111。表更长时只会更糟：n 的 n 次方条路径分给 n 的阶乘种顺序，n 大于 2 时永远分不均。

lineNotes.en: A generator expression: 6000 random lists of picks, made one at a time as count_orders asks for them.
lineNotes.zh: 一个生成器表达式：6000 张随机挑选表，count_orders 要一张才造一张。
